interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked mid-block or intersection crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing zones.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Incorporate street trees in the buffer zone to narrow the perceived width of the street and provide a physical barrier for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the parking lot entrance and clearly define the pedestrian path with a continuous sidewalk level and material.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Furniture Zone Designation
interventions.description: Establish a dedicated furniture zone for utilities and trash bins to ensure a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Buffers
interventions.description: Install curb extensions or a planting strip to provide physical separation between the walkway and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or textured paving at the driveway crossing to alert drivers to the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB) to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street furniture zone
interventions.description: Designate specific areas for trash bins and signs to keep the pedestrian clear path unobstructed.

interventions.title: Lane Striping and Road Diet
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings to organize traffic and consider narrowing travel lanes to naturally reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to ensure the walkway and potential crossing areas are well-illuminated at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees to provide a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Traffic calming
interventions.description: Introduce speed humps or raised crossings to slow vehicle speeds in this high-pedestrian-activity commercial area.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians in this commercial zone.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Remove the discarded mattress and debris to restore the full width of the pedestrian walkway.

interventions.title: Street trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Speed Management
interventions.description: Introduce traffic calming measures such as speed humps or raised crossings to reduce vehicle speeds in this mixed-use area.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install permanent bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk while maintaining pedestrian access.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Zone Enforcement
interventions.description: Establish and enforce a clear walking zone free of commercial equipment, trailers, and signage to ensure ADA compliance and safety.

interventions.title: Street Lighting and Greenery
interventions.description: Add street trees and pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and create a more defined, comfortable pedestrian realm.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to provide a physical and psychological barrier between the walkway and traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or a furniture zone to create a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.
